items.title: Blackstone, Warburg Pincus, Apollo in Talks to Back GTCR's NT$1.6 Trillion Take-Private of Global Payments
items.subject: Apollo
items.why: Warburg Pincus is reported to be moving on Apollo in North Asia (NT$1.6 Trillion): a buy-side tech DD is being scoped now in fintech.
items.call: Call the Warburg Pincus North Asia deal team today and offer to scope the buy-side tech DD before advisers are set.
